representations.A_available_date_sequence: ordered sequence of grid years 2018..survey_year per field
representations.B_season_aligned_sequence: per-season composite columns (Kharif_* / Rabi_*) aligned across the same grid years
representations.C_fixed_temporal_bins: the 2018..2021 grid years ARE fixed annual bins; every bin is an observed grid composite, never imputed

missingness.missing_policy: unmatched slots are kept as explicit missing (never imputed as real observations); temporal aggregates are computed over matched slots only

season_aligned.note: each DK grid year carries a full per-season composite set ("Annual + Kharif/Rabi composites"); the season-aligned sequence uses the Kharif_* columns across years for Kharif fields and Rabi_* for Rabi fields, and BOTH are emitted every year for every field

template: grid years <= survey year define the leading window; 2020 fields -> [2018, 2019, 2020]; 2021 fields -> [2018, 2019, 2020, 2021]
